chapter: Swing, singers, Ed Fox and recordings
title: Freddie Webster and Hines's ear for talent
summary: Webster in later years; talent passing through.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Yeah. When was Freddie Webster in the band?
I can't remember. It was a short stay. That was in the later years.
When we got Freddie Webster, I think that's the same time we got Kansas.
I know Freddie has been cited as one of the models for Miles Davis's style.
There's a lot of talent went through Hines' band. His great ear for talent. Sarah Vaughan was in the band; of course Billy, Billy Eckstine.
